posts.meta_description:
136 likes, 39 comments - mash_india on October 2, 2026: "THE LOST WORLD: THE ART OF MINNIE EVANS

Dreams, spirituality, mythology and the natural world converge in the visionary work of Minnie Evans (1892–1987). Her intricate drawings, paintings and collages bring together angels, mythical creatures, watchful faces and elaborate patterns, creating a deeply personal visual language shaped by her Afro-Caribbean heritage, religion and the landscape of Wilmington, North Carolina.

The Lost World: The Art of Minnie Evans brings together decades of Evans’s work, offering a closer look at an artist whose radiant, kaleidoscopic compositions blur the boundaries between the everyday and the divine.
On view: 22 August 2026 – 10 January 2027
 Location: Whitney Museum of American Art, New York
 Gallery: Floor 8

@whitneymuseum

#MASHIndia #MinnieEvans #TheLostWorld #WhitneyMuseum".
